headline: Petrobras Keeps Natural Gas Sale Prices to Distributors Stable
summary: Petrobras will maintain the average selling price of natural gas to distributors stable for the current quarter compared to the previous period, citing a temporary price volatility reduction mechanism.
why: Stable energy feedstock pricing impacts downstream utility operators and industrial consumer input costs.

impacts.name: Petrobras
impacts.why: Price stability mechanisms affect revenue recognition and predictability for gas sales.
